en.topic_title: Hong Kong lawmakers’ monthly pay tops HK$110K after unannounced 1.6% salary rise
en.topic_summary:
Hong Kong lawmakers have been given a pay rise retroactive to October 1 after a one-year pay freeze, bringing their monthly basic salary to more than HK$110,000.



Outgoing and newly elected Hong Kong lawmakers meet the press on December 9, 2025. Photo: HKFP.



Sing Tao Daily reported on Tuesday morning that legislators had received an unannounced 1.6 per cent pay rise, although the Legislative Council updated figures on its website.
